name: websit
description: Ban-proof lightweight Solana token discovery platform with 5 core metrics

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run deploy:frontend
scripts.deploy:frontend: node -e "import fs from 'fs'; fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'backend/public', { recursive: true, force: true });"
